articles.headline: Will Nvidia Follow Amazon's Dot-Com Path? Jeremy Grantham Warns Of Brutal Tech Stock Reversal
articles.summary: Billionaire Jeremy Grantham warns the AI stock bubble will burst, predicting a 70% market crash and an Amazon-like 92% drop for AI giants.
articles._summary: While acknowledging that artificial intelligence is a “dazzlingly important idea” that will fundamentally change human life, Grantham argued that the technology is repeating a historical pattern of speculative excess. Major inventions, including railroads and the early internet, have always triggered immense psychological hype, leading to severely overvalued markets . “We all want to put our money in it… and it sucks in more than you can shake a stick at and you get overinvestment,” Grantham told CNBC.

articles.headline: Nikki Haley Wants Trump Administration To Continue Sanctioning Iran As Fragile Ceasefire Faces New Tests: 'Keep The Pressure On' (CORRECTED)
articles.summary: Former US Ambassador Nikki Haley urges keeping strict sanctions on Iran, pressuring China and Russia to stop support.
articles._summary: Editor’s Note: The headline has been corrected to fix a typographical error. Former U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley urged the Trump administration to keep strict sanctions on Iran, refuse to unfreeze Iranian assets and pressure China and Russia to stop buying Iranian oil and supplying equipment to Tehran, arguing that Washington should starve the regime of money rather than ease up after a fragile ceasefire. "Keep the sanctions on Iran. Don’t unfreeze their assets. Put the pressure on China and Russia to stop buying oil and supplying Iran with equipment," Haley wrote Sunday on X. "The administration did the bulk of the work. Reversing the progress that was made is a waste. Keep the pressure on and have the gulf states support that pressure. You have to stop their ability to get any money," she added.

articles._zh_summary: 编者注：标题已更正，以修复印刷错误。美国前驻联合国大使妮基·黑利敦促特朗普政府继续对伊朗实施严格制裁，拒绝解冻伊朗资产，并向中国和俄罗斯施压，停止购买伊朗石油和向德黑兰供应设备，她认为华盛顿应该让伊朗政权陷入资金匮乏，而不是在脆弱的停火后放松警惕。黑利周日在X上写道：“继续对伊朗实施制裁。不要解冻他们的资产。向中国和俄罗斯施加压力，要求他们停止购买石油和向伊朗提供设备。政府已经完成了大部分工作。扭转已经取得的进展是一种浪费。继续施加压力，并让海湾国家支持这种压力。你必须阻止他们获得任何资金的能力。”

articles.headline: Trade tensions shake up Brazil's caipirinha spirit
articles.summary: U.S. tariff pressure is pushing Europe and Brazil closer—opening new global doors for everything from aircraft parts to Brazil's cachaça, the base of the caipirinha.
articles._summary: Bartender Rafaella Demelo adds sugar, 1.5 ounces of Leblon, and half a lime over ice in a shaker while preparing a caipirinha, Brazil's trademark cocktail. Alan Diaz/AP hide caption RIO DE JANEIRO, Brazil—The Trump administration's tariffs may have done what decades of diplomacy couldn't: convince Europe and South America they needed each other. For Brazil's cachaça makers, that diplomatic shift is already becoming a business opportunity. "I think growth will be immense," distiller Assja Schymura of Pindorama, said. "If we can only get over these initial barriers." Cachaça, Brazil's sugarcane-based liquor and the key ingredient in the country's famed cocktail, the caipirinha, has won awards in European competitions but has long struggled to break into the market. Import taxes and lack of familiarity kept it mostly a niche export. Producers now see a chance to change that.
articles._zh_headline: 贸易紧张局势动摇了巴西的凯匹林纳精神
articles._zh_summary: 调酒师 Rafaella Demelo 在调制巴西标志性鸡尾酒凯匹林纳鸡尾酒时，将糖、1.5 盎司 Leblon 和半个青柠放入摇酒壶中加冰块。艾伦·迪亚兹/美联社隐藏标题巴西里约热内卢——特朗普政府的关税可能做到了数十年外交无法做到的事情：让欧洲和南美洲相信他们彼此需要。对于巴西的卡莎萨生产商来说，这种外交转变已经成为一个商机。 Pindorama 的酿酒师 Assja Schymura 表示：“我认为增长将是巨大的。” “如果我们能够克服这些最初的障碍就好了。” Cachaça 是巴西以甘蔗为原料的酒，也是该国著名鸡尾酒凯匹林纳鸡尾酒的主要成分，它曾在欧洲比赛中获奖，但长期以来一直难以打入市场。进口税和缺乏熟悉度使其主要成为利基出口产品。制片人现在看到了改变这种状况的机会。

articles.author: Benzinga Weekend Correspondent
articles.headline: BIS Flags Rising Global Risks as Middle East Conflict, Oil Losses and AI‑Investment Boom Collide
articles.summary: The global economy has displayed “surprising resilience” despite the Middle East conflict and tariffs, driven partly by artificial intelligence-related investments.
articles._summary: The global economy has displayed "surprising resilience" despite the Middle East conflict and tariffs, driven partly by artificial intelligence-related investments. That fortitude may be under threat, the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) said in its annual report on Sunday. "The global economy remains caught in the crosscurrents of progress and peril," the BIS said. "The perils have grown with pressure points around risks of persistent inflation, the sustainability of AI-related investments, growing financial vulnerabilities and weakening fiscal positions." The energy shock due to the war in the Middle East has accelerated inflation and slowed global economic growth. Prices in the US rose to a three-year high of 4.2% in May. The energy index increased 23.5% for the 12 months ending May. That inflation shock has already forced institutions to reassess the outlook.
articles._zh_headline: 国际清算银行指出，中东冲突、石油损失和人工智能投资热潮相互碰撞，全球风险不断上升
articles._zh_summary: 尽管存在中东冲突和关税，全球经济仍表现出“惊人的弹性”，部分原因是人工智能相关投资。国际清算银行（BIS）在周日的年度报告中表示，这种毅力可能受到威胁。国际清算银行表示：“全球经济仍然陷入进步与危险的矛盾之中。” “随着持续通胀风险、人工智能相关投资的可持续性、金融脆弱性加剧和财政状况疲软等压力点，危险也在增加。”中东战争造成的能源冲击加速了通货膨胀，减缓了全球经济增长。 5 月份美国物价上涨 4.2%，创三年新高。截至 5 月份的 12 个月内，能源指数上涨了 23.5%。通胀冲击已经迫使机构重新评估前景。
